harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Created a local CA named "OS Comparison Root CA" on node1 (Alpine Linux) and installed it as a trusted system CA. Verified trust functionally (openssl verify against a leaf cert issued by the CA succeeds using the system trust store). Performed the mandatory single-node restart: captured baseline boot_id, rebooted node1, confirmed the boot_id changed post-restart, and re-verified the CA file and system trust chain survived and remain functional.
actions_performed: Inspected node1 OS (Alpine Linux 3.23) and found openssl/ca-certificates not installed
Installed openssl and ca-certificates via apk
Generated a 4096-bit RSA key and self-signed X.509 CA certificate with CN="OS Comparison Root CA", CA:TRUE basicConstraints, 10-year validity, stored in /root/ca
Copied the CA cert to /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/ and ran update-ca-certificates to install it into the system trust store
Verified the CA appears in /etc/ssl/certs (symlink) and inside the combined /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt bundle
Issued a test leaf certificate signed by the new CA and confirmed openssl verify trusts it via the system CA path, then cleaned up test files
Captured baseline boot_id (5fb51002-fee2-4de5-a43d-805c7a885423) as pre-restart evidence
Triggered a backgrounded reboot on node1 so the acknowledgement returned before disconnect
Polled node1 until command execution resumed and confirmed a new boot_id (7d5b05a1-8d35-4a47-86b8-618257329650), proving the restart occurred
Post-restart, verified the CA cert/key files persisted on disk and the CA remains present in the system trust bundle
Post-restart, issued and verified a second leaf certificate to functionally prove the CA trust configuration survived the reboot

evidence.requirement: CA 'OS Comparison Root CA' created on node1
evidence.summary: Generated CA key/cert; openssl x509 shows subject=issuer=CN=OS Comparison Root CA, 10-year validity.

evidence.requirement: CA certificate installed as trusted system CA
evidence.summary: Installed openssl/ca-certificates packages, copied cert to /usr/local/share/ca-certificates and ran update-ca-certificates; symlinks ca-cert-os-comparison-root-ca.pem and hash ca763292.0 created in /etc/ssl/certs.
Extracted CA subject from the combined trust bundle and confirmed 'OS Comparison Root CA' is present; issued a leaf cert and openssl verify -CApath /etc/ssl/certs returned OK.
Captured boot_id 5fb51002-fee2-4de5-a43d-805c7a885423 and uptime before restart.
Backgrounded reboot command acknowledged (exit_code 0, 'reboot-scheduled') before the connection dropped.
After connection-reset/timeout errors during reboot, boot_id read as 7d5b05a1-8d35-4a47-86b8-618257329650, differing from the pre-restart value.

evidence.requirement: node1 post-restart recovery of CA/trust state
evidence.summary: Confirmed CA cert files persisted and remained in the system trust bundle post-reboot; issued and verified a new leaf certificate (openssl verify OK), proving functional recovery.
